Empty request: candidate algebra.py:751-754 handles prepareUpdate("") and processUpdate("") without error. Reference.diff leaves `return res`, so prepareUpdate("") there fails (it sets _original_args on a list). This is a candidate improvement.

Defect: algebra.py:753 calls translatePrologue(q.prologue, base, initNs) with the whole plist of per-update groups. parserutils.py:226-243 builds q.prologue as a plist of groups, and parserutils.py:82-95 unwraps each single-element token. translatePrologue (algebra.py:684-701) expects ONE group and iterates `for x in p` with `x.name == "PrefixDecl"` (:695-699). The group's .name resolves to "" (pyparsing 2.4.7 ParseResults.__getattr__, /usr/lib/python3/dist-packages/pyparsing.py:841-845), so no declaration is bound. The correct per-group call is the one used at algebra.py:755-756.

Consequence: prepareUpdate("PREFIX ex: <urn:ex:>") returns a Prologue with no ex binding. The candidate's own test_declarations_only_request_keeps_prologue (test_sparql_prepared_update.py:77-83) asserts resolvePName("ex","x") == URIRef("urn:ex:x"); by reading, Prologue.resolvePName (sparql.py ~373-377) raises "Unknown namespace prefix : ex". So that test would fail. Evaluation is unaffected because there are no operations, but the returned container's prologue is wrong for declaration-only requests. Reference.diff crashes on this input instead, so the candidate's behavior here is its own extension, and that extension is incorrect.
criteria.deficiency: Empty-request branch passes q.prologue (plist of groups) to translatePrologue, which expects one group (algebra.py:753 vs 755-756 and 684-701). PREFIX/BASE declarations in a request with no operations are silently dropped, so prepared.prologue lacks them; the candidate's test at test_sparql_prepared_update.py:77-83 asserts the opposite and would fail by reading. Fix: iterate the groups, e.g. `for p in q.prologue: prologue = translatePrologue(p, base, initNs, prologue)`, or handle the empty case without changing the shared pipeline.
